sections.Profile:
"West Club" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Rally Play Company in April 1967. Designed for two players, it features two flippers, three pop bumpers, four slingshots, and seven standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Rally play Company
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Original Theme
